card.name: Faculty and staff profile page text
card.fires_on: Words in web pages about a named person, such as a faculty or staff bio or contact block. It marks things like profile URLs, Office Hours, an email @, a Dr title, or a sentence start in a bio.

modes.label: Contact and directory details

modes.label: Bio sentence openings
modes.description: A sentence start or end in a personal bio, such as a pronoun or I.
modes.example: Jason Nunn is a Personal Trainer and Sports Performance Coach in Indianapolis, Indiana.<< He>> is the Owner of Nunn’s Performance

card.plain: It lights up in personal web pages for staff or faculty, around contact details and bio sentences.
